top_signals.title: Sprake: Markets Punch-Drunk on AI Capex Spend
top_signals.summary:
Brent crude held below 80 dollars a barrel on hopes for progress towards a Hormuz deal, while Treasury yields remained lower as easing oil prices reduced pressure on the Federal Reserve. AG Capital's Market Strategist Casey Sprake spoke to Bloomberg’s Abeer Abu Omar on Horizons Middle East & Africa on the market moves.
 (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
